data.one_liner: Parses Indonesian QRIS codes into merchant and transaction data.
data.what_it_does: The qris package takes a raw QRIS string and extracts useful information such as merchant name, ID, transaction amount, and point of initiation. It provides convenient getters for each field and validates the CRC and check digit.
use_when: You need to read and interpret a QRIS code in a Flutter app
You want a lightweight, pure Dart solution without external dependencies
avoid_when: You need to generate QRIS codes
You require a full barcode scanning solution
strengths: Pure Dart, no build_runner or code generation
Built-in CRC and check digit validation
weaknesses: Documentation is limited to core fields
